current_answer: Kiro offers up to one year of Pro+ credits to selected early-stage through Series A teams, but its public page specifies VC backing. An active AWS Activate balance disqualifies a startup from the separate Kiro promotion; Activate credits can instead cover Kiro. A team that receives Kiro credits may later apply for Activate if eligible. The Kiro offer closes 31 December 2026; credits start on issuance and switch to standard billing when spent or expired. Exact VC proof and package allocation are unknown.

catalogue_card.question: Can you add Kiro’s one-year credits to AWS Activate?
catalogue_card.text: No. Kiro’s separate Pro+ startup promotion excludes active AWS Activate credit holders. Activate credits may cover Kiro instead. Kiro targets early-stage to Series A VC-backed teams; apply by 31 December 2026, and plan for standard Pro+ billing after its one-year credit ends.

summary: Kiro lists up to one year of Pro+ credits for selected early-stage to Series A VC-backed startups, with 2-, 10- and 30-user packages.
Active AWS Activate credits exclude the separate Kiro promotion; Activate credits can cover Kiro. A Kiro recipient may later apply for Activate if eligible.
Application ends 31 December 2026; Kiro credit starts at issuance, expires one year later, and switches to standard billing when used or expired.
